hero.subtitle: where ideas take shapes — a creative agency shaping brands, stories, and moments from scratch.

paragraphs: We're Dough — a creative agency shaping brands, stories, and moments from scratch.
From bold concepts to scroll-stopping content, we don't just follow culture — we bake it fresh.
Agile, obsessive, and unafraid of the unconventional, we work with brands ready to leave a mark, not just make a sale.

whyUs.title: Why Us
whyUs.subtitle: How we bake, shape, and rise to make raw concepts stand out from the noise.

points.title: MAGIC OF CREATIVITY & INNOVATION
points.content: At Dough, we believe in the magic of creativity and the power of innovation.

points.title: MOLDING IDEAS INTO REALITY
points.content: Just like dough that can be molded into any shape, we shape ideas into reality.

points.title: VERSATILE & ADAPTABLE TEAM
points.content: Our team is as versatile and adaptable as the dough itself — ready to rise to any challenge.

points.title: MIXING STRATEGY WITH PASSION
points.content: We mix creativity with strategy, knead it with passion, and bake it with precision.

points.title: CONSTANT EVOLUTION & RISING
points.content: Just like the perfect dough, we're always evolving and rising to the occasion.

points.title: PLAYFUL PROFESSIONALISM
points.content: We have a pinch of fun and a dash of cleverness — because who says business can't be a little playful?

steps.title: DISCOVERY
steps.body: We dig in deep — brand audits, market pulse, and real convos. We listen more than we talk (for now).

steps.title: STRATEGY
steps.body: We knead the insights into a tight, tasty plan. Positioning, voice, goals — it all starts here.

steps.title: CREATIVE DEVELOPMENT
steps.body: From zero to concept — this is where your brand gets its flavor. Visuals, copy, packaging, campaigns — all baked in.

steps.title: EXECUTION
steps.body: We bring the heat. Whether it's content, media, or a full-on launch — our team rolls it out, pixel by pixel, post by post.

steps.title: OPTIMIZATION
steps.body: We don't 'set and forget.' We test, tweak, and turn insights into sharper moves.
